name: Kandle - Component Manager
description: Import and manage third-party components in KiCad.
description_full: Kandle imports third-party symbols, footprints and 3D models (SnapEDA, Ultra Librarian, Component Search Engine) into a KiCad project. Drag a vendor .zip into the Kandle window, choose or create a component type, optionally rename the component, and Kandle sorts the symbol, footprint and 3D model into a tidy library structure, links them, registers the project library tables and refreshes KiCad. The same window doubles as a component manager for renaming and deleting imported components.
